### The Fairphone Gen. 6: Modular, durable, long-lasting

The Fairphone (Gen. 6) is built to last in every way. It’s tough and durable, made with scratch-resistant Gorilla Glass 7i, and drop-tested from a height of 1.8 meters. It’s weatherproof with an IP55 rating, and comes with a five-year warranty, and software support through 2033. That’s at least eight years of updates, with seven Android upgrades included. On top of this, spare parts availability is guaranteed till 2033 (at least).

And then there’s our extremely easy-to-maintain modular design: the battery, the screen, the speaker, the cameras are all replaceable. This is expected from us by now. But we’ve taken modularity even further this time. Not just modular for repair, but modular for personalization.
